name: Amoxicillin
uses: Treats bacterial infections including pneumonia, ear infections, UTIs, and skin infections. Common brands in Kenya: Amoxil.
dosage: Adults: 250-500mg every 8 hours. Children: 25mg/kg/day in divided doses.
side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, rash, allergic reactions.

name: Paracetamol
uses: Relieves mild to moderate pain and reduces fever. Common brands in Kenya: Panadol, Calpol.
dosage: Adults: 500-1000mg every 4-6 hours. Max 4g/day. Children: 10-15mg/kg every 4-6 hours.
side_effects: Rarely causes side effects at normal doses. Overdose can cause liver damage.

name: Metformin
uses: Controls blood sugar levels in type 2 diabetes. Common brands in Kenya: Glucophage.
dosage: Adults: 500mg twice daily with meals. Max 2000mg/day.
side_effects: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach upset.

name: Ibuprofen
uses: Reduces pain, fever and inflammation. Used for headaches, arthritis, menstrual cramps. Common brands in Kenya: Brufen.
dosage: Adults: 200-400mg every 4-6 hours. Max 1200mg/day without prescription.
side_effects: Stomach upset, heartburn, nausea, increased bleeding risk.

name: Ciprofloxacin
uses: Treats urinary tract infections, respiratory infections, typhoid fever. Common brands in Kenya: Ciproxin.
dosage: Adults: 250-750mg twice daily for 7-14 days.
side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, tendon damage with prolonged use.

name: Artemether/Lumefantrine
uses: First-line treatment for uncomplicated malaria in Kenya. Common brands in Kenya: Coartem.
dosage: Adults: 4 tablets at 0, 8, 24, 36, 48, 60 hours (6 doses total).
side_effects: Headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite.

name: Omeprazole
uses: Treats acid reflux, stomach ulcers, and heartburn. Common brands in Kenya: Losec.
dosage: Adults: 20-40mg once daily before meals.
side_effects: Headache, nausea, diarrhea, stomach pain.

name: Amlodipine
uses: Treats high blood pressure and chest pain (angina). Common brands in Kenya: Norvasc.
dosage: Adults: 5-10mg once daily.
side_effects: Swelling of ankles, flushing, headache, dizziness.

name: Metronidazole
uses: Treats amoebic dysentery, giardiasis, bacterial vaginosis, trichomoniasis and other anaerobic infections. Common brands in Kenya: Flagyl.
dosage: Adults: 400mg every 8 hours for 5-7 days, depending on the infection. Complete the full course.
side_effects: Metallic taste, nausea, dark urine. Drinking alcohol during treatment and for 48 hours after can cause severe vomiting and flushing.

name: Cotrimoxazole
uses: Treats urinary tract and chest infections, and prevents infections in people living with HIV. Common brands in Kenya: Septrin.
dosage: Adults: 960mg twice daily for treatment. For prevention in HIV: 960mg once daily, as directed by your clinic.
side_effects: Nausea, rash. Stop and seek care urgently if a rash, blisters or mouth sores appear.

name: Amoxicillin/Clavulanic Acid
uses: Treats sinus, ear, chest, skin and urinary infections, and infected bites. Common brands in Kenya: Augmentin.
dosage: Adults: 625mg every 8 hours or 1g twice daily for 5-7 days, with food.
side_effects: Diarrhoea, nausea, oral or vaginal thrush, rash. Rarely, liver problems.

name: Doxycycline
uses: Treats chest infections, chlamydia and other STIs, and acne; also used to prevent malaria when travelling.
dosage: Adults: usually 200mg on day 1, then 100mg daily, as prescribed. Swallow with a full glass of water while sitting upright. Not for children under 8.
side_effects: Sunburn more easily, nausea, heartburn or throat irritation if taken lying down.

name: Azithromycin
uses: Treats chest infections, typhoid, trachoma and some sexually transmitted infections. Common brands in Kenya: Zithromax.
dosage: Adults: commonly 500mg once daily for 3 days; some infections use a single dose. Follow the prescription.
side_effects: Diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain.

name: Flucloxacillin
uses: Treats skin and soft-tissue infections such as boils, cellulitis and infected wounds.
dosage: Adults: 250-500mg every 6 hours, 1 hour before food, usually for 5-7 days.
side_effects: Nausea, diarrhoea, rash. Rarely, jaundice, which can appear weeks after the course.

name: Nitrofurantoin
uses: Treats and prevents uncomplicated urinary tract infections (bladder infections).
dosage: Adults: 100mg every 12 hours with food for 5 days, or as prescribed.
side_effects: Nausea, harmless brown urine. Rarely, lung or liver reactions with long-term use.

name: Ceftriaxone
uses: Injection for serious infections such as meningitis, severe pneumonia, typhoid and gonorrhoea. Common brands in Kenya: Rocephin.
dosage: Adults: 1-2g once daily by injection, given by a health worker.
side_effects: Pain at the injection site, diarrhoea, rash.

name: Dihydroartemisinin/Piperaquine
uses: Treats uncomplicated malaria; an alternative to artemether/lumefantrine. Common brands in Kenya: Duo-Cotecxin, P-Alaxin.
dosage: Once daily for 3 days, dose by body weight. Take on an empty stomach, not with fatty food.
side_effects: Headache, dizziness, nausea, palpitations.

name: Artesunate Injection
uses: Treats severe malaria in hospital, until the patient can take tablets.
dosage: Given by injection in hospital, dose by body weight, followed by a full course of tablets.
side_effects: Dizziness, nausea. Rarely, anaemia in the weeks after treatment.

name: Sulfadoxine/Pyrimethamine
uses: Prevents malaria in pregnancy (IPTp), from the second trimester, given at the antenatal clinic. Not given to women taking cotrimoxazole. Common brands in Kenya: Fansidar.
dosage: 3 tablets as a single dose, at scheduled antenatal visits at least one month apart.
side_effects: Nausea. Stop and seek care urgently if a rash, blisters or mouth sores appear.

name: Albendazole
uses: Treats and prevents intestinal worms such as roundworm, hookworm and whipworm. Common brands in Kenya: Zentel.
dosage: Adults and children over 2: 400mg as a single dose. Children 1-2 years: 200mg.
side_effects: Stomach pain, nausea, headache.

name: Praziquantel
uses: Treats bilharzia (schistosomiasis) and tapeworm. Common brands in Kenya: Biltricide.
dosage: Bilharzia: 40mg/kg body weight as a single dose, with food. 600mg tablets.
side_effects: Dizziness, drowsiness, headache, stomach pain, nausea.

name: Mebendazole
uses: Treats intestinal worms including threadworm, roundworm and hookworm. Common brands in Kenya: Vermox.
dosage: Adults and children over 2: 500mg as a single dose, or 100mg twice daily for 3 days.
side_effects: Stomach pain, diarrhoea.

name: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS)
uses: Replaces water and salts lost through diarrhoea or vomiting. The first treatment for diarrhoea at any age.
dosage: Mix one sachet with the amount of clean water on the pack. Sip often. After each loose stool: children under 2, 50-100ml; children 2-10, 100-200ml; older children and adults, as much as wanted.
side_effects: Vomiting if drunk too quickly; wait 10 minutes and continue more slowly.

name: Zinc Sulfate
uses: Given with ORS to children with diarrhoea; shortens the illness and helps prevent the next episode.
dosage: Children 6 months and over: 20mg once daily for 10-14 days. Under 6 months: 10mg daily. Dissolve the tablet in a little water or breast milk.
side_effects: Nausea or vomiting, especially on an empty stomach.

name: Loperamide
uses: Short-term relief of acute diarrhoea in adults. Common brands in Kenya: Imodium.
dosage: Adults: 4mg at first, then 2mg after each loose stool. Max 16mg/day. Not for children under 12, or for diarrhoea with blood or fever.
side_effects: Constipation, stomach cramps, dizziness.

name: Ferrous Sulfate/Folic Acid
uses: Prevents anaemia in pregnancy and helps prevent birth defects of the spine and brain.
dosage: One tablet (60mg elemental iron + 400mcg folic acid) daily throughout pregnancy, as given at the antenatal clinic. Best taken between meals.
side_effects: Dark stools, constipation, nausea.

name: Salbutamol Inhaler
uses: Quickly relieves wheezing and breathlessness in asthma and COPD. Common brands in Kenya: Ventolin. Kenya's 2023 Essential Medicines List uses a combined salbutamol + beclomethasone inhaler instead; relying on salbutamol alone, without a preventer inhaler, is not recommended for ongoing asthma.
dosage: 1-2 puffs (100-200mcg) when needed, up to 4 times a day. Needing it more often means asthma is not controlled: see a clinician.
side_effects: Shaky hands, fast heartbeat, headache.

name: Prednisolone
uses: Reduces inflammation in severe asthma attacks, allergic reactions and some skin and joint conditions.
dosage: Dose depends on the condition, e.g. 40-50mg once daily for 5 days in an asthma attack. Take in the morning with food. Do not stop suddenly after a long course.
side_effects: Raised blood sugar, mood changes, stomach irritation, higher risk of infection.

name: Cetirizine
uses: Relieves hay fever, itchy skin, hives and other allergies. Common brands in Kenya: Zyrtec.
dosage: Adults: 10mg once daily.
side_effects: Mild drowsiness, dry mouth, headache.

name: Chlorphenamine
uses: Relieves allergies, hay fever, itching and insect bites. Common brands in Kenya: Piriton.
dosage: Adults: 4mg every 4-6 hours. Max 24mg/day.
side_effects: Drowsiness (do not drive), dry mouth, blurred vision.

name: Hydrochlorothiazide
uses: Lowers high blood pressure and reduces fluid swelling.
dosage: Adults: 12.5-25mg once daily in the morning.
side_effects: Passing urine more often, dizziness, low potassium, gout flare.

name: Enalapril
uses: Treats high blood pressure and heart failure, and protects the kidneys in diabetes. Common brands in Kenya: Renitec.
dosage: Adults: usually 5-20mg once daily, up to 40mg/day.
side_effects: Dry cough, dizziness, high potassium. Must not be taken in pregnancy.

name: Losartan
uses: Treats high blood pressure and protects the kidneys in diabetes; used when enalapril causes a cough. Common brands in Kenya: Cozaar.
dosage: Adults: 50mg once daily, adjusted between 25-100mg.
side_effects: Dizziness, high potassium. Must not be taken in pregnancy.

name: Gliclazide
uses: Lowers blood sugar in type 2 diabetes, often with metformin. Can be used in chronic kidney disease. Common brands in Kenya: Diamicron.
dosage: Adults: standard tablets 40-80mg once daily with breakfast, up to 160mg twice daily. Modified-release: 30-120mg once daily with breakfast.
side_effects: Low blood sugar (shaking, sweating, confusion), especially if meals are missed or with alcohol. Weight gain.

name: Diclofenac
uses: Relieves pain and inflammation in arthritis, back pain, sprains and period pain. Common brands in Kenya: Voltaren. Not on Kenya's 2023 Essential Medicines List; ibuprofen is the listed alternative.
dosage: Adults: 50mg 2-3 times daily with food. Max 150mg/day.
side_effects: Stomach pain, ulcers and bleeding, raised blood pressure, kidney strain.

name: Hyoscine Butylbromide
uses: Relieves stomach cramps, irritable bowel spasms and period cramps. Common brands in Kenya: Buscopan.
dosage: Adults: 10-20mg up to 4 times daily.
side_effects: Dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, fast heartbeat.

name: Fluconazole
uses: Treats vaginal thrush and other yeast infections, including oral thrush. Common brands in Kenya: Diflucan.
dosage: Vaginal thrush: 150mg as a single dose. Other infections as prescribed.
side_effects: Nausea, headache, stomach pain.

name: Clotrimazole
uses: Cream for ringworm, athlete's foot and skin thrush; pessary for vaginal thrush. Common brands in Kenya: Canesten.
dosage: Cream: apply 2-3 times daily, continuing 2 weeks after it clears. Pessary: 500mg at night as a single dose.
side_effects: Mild burning or irritation where applied.

name: Tenofovir/Lamivudine/Dolutegravir (TLD)
uses: First-line HIV treatment in Kenya. Taken every day for life, it keeps the virus suppressed. Never stop or skip doses without talking to your HIV clinic.
dosage: One tablet once daily at the same time every day.
side_effects: Headache, difficulty sleeping, weight gain.

name: Levonorgestrel (Emergency Contraceptive)
uses: Emergency contraception after unprotected sex. It is not an abortion pill and does not protect against HIV or other STIs. Common brands in Kenya: Postinor-2.
dosage: 1.5mg as a single dose as soon as possible, within 72 hours of unprotected sex.
side_effects: Nausea, headache, irregular bleeding until the next period.

name: Salbutamol/Beclomethasone Inhaler
uses: Relieves asthma symptoms while treating the airway inflammation behind them. The reliever inhaler on Kenya's 2023 Essential Medicines List.
dosage: 100mcg salbutamol + 50mcg beclomethasone per puff. 1-2 puffs when needed for symptoms, as prescribed. Rinse the mouth after use.
side_effects: Shaky hands, fast heartbeat, hoarse voice, oral thrush.
